questions.question: In an adult presenting with fulminant sepsis four days after a dog bite, which empiric intravenous antibiotic regimens appropriately cover Capnocytophaga and other dog-bite flora, and what features of the organism and wound microbiology justify this choice?

A septic patient initially meeting criteria for disseminated intravascular coagulation later shows an isolated drop in hemoglobin with undetectable haptoglobin, rising LDH, persistent thrombocytopenia, and normalizing PT/aPTT. Which clinical and laboratory features most strongly suggest superimposed thrombotic microangiopathy rather than ongoing DIC?

In an adult with microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, and acute kidney injury, what laboratory test must be sent urgently to evaluate for thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura, and what ADAMTS13 activity threshold essentially rules out TTP?

A patient with hemolysis has a direct antiglobulin test (IgG) initially positive while receiving penicillin and after recent transfusions. What are two common causes of a false-positive DAT in this context, and what bedside clues help distinguish autoimmune hemolysis from microangiopathic hemolysis?

Describe how dysregulation of the alternative complement pathway leads to endothelial injury and thrombotic microangiopathy in complement-mediated HUS, including why serum C3/C4 levels and standard pathway assays can remain normal during active disease.

In suspected complement-mediated HUS complicating recent bacteremia, outline immediate management while awaiting ADAMTS13 and Shiga-toxin results: when to initiate plasma exchange as a bridge, when to start eculizumab, and how to mitigate infectious risk with meningococcal vaccination and antibiotic prophylaxis.

What are the characteristic kidney biopsy findings of thrombotic microangiopathy on light microscopy, and how do immunofluorescence and electron microscopy help distinguish TMA from immune complex–mediated glomerulonephritides?

How do plasma exchange and eculizumab therapy alter the interpretation of complement studies (for example, AH50 and C3/C4), and how should the timing of sampling relative to these therapies influence diagnostic conclusions?

What clinical factors predict renal recovery and guide duration of complement blockade in complement-mediated HUS, and how do time-to-eculizumab initiation and the presence or absence of pathogenic complement gene variants inform these decisions?

What clinical syndromes and risk factors are associated with Capnocytophaga canimorsus infection, why is diagnosis often delayed, and which diagnostic methods can improve detection in suspected invasive disease?
